claims.head: The Blues like Suter’s line against Poitras’s
claims.call: The Blues’ L4 (Kaskimäki, Suter and Stenberg) spends at least 46% of its 5-on-5 time against the Bruins’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Blues keep sending Suter’s line (Kaskimäki, Suter and Stenberg) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jim Montgomery keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Bruins’ fourth line is Jeannot, Kastelic and Poitras.
claims.nums: At home: 46% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 19% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Jim Montgomery likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Bruins’ fourth line.

STL.head: The matchup suits the Blues
STL.body: St. Louis has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Bruins’ way back in is a penalty kill that holds up.

BOS.head: Not an easy night for the Bruins
BOS.body: St. Louis has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Bruins can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.

paras: The Bruins come in at 9-3-1, the Blues at 5-6-1.
